findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "context-review?channel=registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: review_context_retention · Private data: review_context_retention · Public sink: review_context_retention.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: review_context_retention · Private data: review_context_retention · Public sink: review_context_retention

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
